Mixing aspirin and alcohol ` [Highlight start] increases the risk of stomach irritation, ulcers, and gastrointestinal bleeding [Highlight end] ` . Both substances irritate the stomach lining, and aspirin also reduces blood clotting, making any bleeding more serious.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXjG7iv7NrkgdOY27AMPr0sfhB3UvulbXoblUly2D49HK1bZzJR8PisAwpsYh37vYI6gJQ34fzvqBzgeAC_bgctFYLik-Xb74TB49g5I0vvF4kOmW7C2XB4xYNHvYG1LymKhCFPA8ItA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXkLt_C0lA3GhRL0g1MLN6c4KRIJl1joyamFSFn5-_rzdpHsuy-ob4fOK6y-7CJzn_CGh7M4wqfmWVfSk0Puj3zH8Ye5iSNY6ORJZOJwtXu_AQlyeoJwVeOez9P3K-9q81PV7f)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXrSDEWs4fuNLMuWiCQioPtxY57NMqpqezZ2h5eJmcx_Q75dnPydY9wdnjYQI3MPPDRMKbxKBAGN3a0AXgwbbg2iL1eKov2xO8M0PkBRB-bmxvL6okAQeyCe_9R2cUWRQZvr6xFPzAnLTIlY3RdPz4HZQuOm1rCqA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXl75ijVma_CY11lHvgkIUaAVpNThlywPvxgqrRAS1bcriArUDilWYRO5tgCAtqj_IuX8vioTY-0CnvjtIlEtLaDPHpuL25kYQsxgiZnmnN8uypnAGimYts9kOnQKJmIwmyZ6NIhnZ)

### Key Risks

- **Stomach upset and ulcers:** Nausea, heartburn, vomiting, and damage to the stomach lining can occur even with low-dose ("baby") aspirin.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXkLt_C0lA3GhRL0g1MLN6c4KRIJl1joyamFSFn5-_rzdpHsuy-ob4fOK6y-7CJzn_CGh7M4wqfmWVfSk0Puj3zH8Ye5iSNY6ORJZOJwtXu_AQlyeoJwVeOez9P3K-9q81PV7f)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXjG7iv7NrkgdOY27AMPr0sfhB3UvulbXoblUly2D49HK1bZzJR8PisAwpsYh37vYI6gJQ34fzvqBzgeAC_bgctFYLik-Xb74TB49g5I0vvF4kOmW7C2XB4xYNHvYG1LymKhCFPA8ItA)
- **Gastrointestinal bleeding:** Heavy or frequent drinking combined with regular aspirin use significantly raises the risk of bleeding in the stomach or intestines.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF113BiDdwTy2rUAc-y9R9T9tomhupW3wsC5BqJSGZXjI7KISRGplbqZk7bvaabCjVG23H_AHeCIVs-AmaA4JRouZmQsP2KZlooh955ImkBVrNZrT5Xk7RwzLQz7kVRJ_ilVvJ4Uud4PJ9DXZwM64xN2DFT2ZHZV8-YRQFgEw-e4wVc2051wJEy_jrBazrMvCSHNtpw8qhjaAWwK_mY9v77ytSBggjJv-lcU0qPHmoUBjx)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXjG7iv7NrkgdOY27AMPr0sfhB3UvulbXoblUly2D49HK1bZzJR8PisAwpsYh37vYI6gJQ34fzvqBzgeAC_bgctFYLik-Xb74TB49g5I0vvF4kOmW7C2XB4xYNHvYG1LymKhCFPA8ItA)
- **Warning signs of bleeding:** Seek immediate medical care if you notice black or tarry stools, blood in your stool, or vomit that looks like blood or coffee grounds.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXywYM10FqCnA2FOqK-XyBl0JYRBsrpC-17u9nR_Ad2z1WLphwZgx0a9ogp6yB-Z8rHjJEL6baVCrLgH2XfWLoY7SNOLZLsIhfDP8hAlg5mhpYWNYG9xr27Rt9yO1JMQapvNgwviGD6MP_xA)

### Practical Precautions

- **Limit alcohol:** If a doctor approves alcohol while you take aspirin, keep intake low—generally no more than 1 drink per day for women and men over 65, and up to 2 drinks per day for men under 65. Avoid heavy or binge drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXjG7iv7NrkgdOY27AMPr0sfhB3UvulbXoblUly2D49HK1bZzJR8PisAwpsYh37vYI6gJQ34fzvqBzgeAC_bgctFYLik-Xb74TB49g5I0vvF4kOmW7C2XB4xYNHvYG1LymKhCFPA8ItA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXrSDEWs4fuNLMuWiCQioPtxY57NMqpqezZ2h5eJmcx_Q75dnPydY9wdnjYQI3MPPDRMKbxKBAGN3a0AXgwbbg2iL1eKov2xO8M0PkBRB-bmxvL6okAQeyCe_9R2cUWRQZvr6xFPzAnLTIlY3RdPz4HZQuOm1rCqA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXGJIx6Qdp1dqsLNSTlw9pmZ_xV6BUqGzl4Am-s1tq0dB6L7nPBT1SVQ2cd8LfnBtqZuYeLmCUJNQw08RBnhUVWhZs5OmbsqtDencDIP7ZJ5mbl_l2-OMJ6vYBWjykIikf1pfjL2Zj3y_mC-1yYw)
- **Space them out:** Avoid taking aspirin immediately before, during, or right after drinking. For more details on timing and side effects, see [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXjG7iv7NrkgdOY27AMPr0sfhB3UvulbXoblUly2D49HK1bZzJR8PisAwpsYh37vYI6gJQ34fzvqBzgeAC_bgctFYLik-Xb74TB49g5I0vvF4kOmW7C2XB4xYNHvYG1LymKhCFPA8ItA).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXkLt_C0lA3GhRL0g1MLN6c4KRIJl1joyamFSFn5-_rzdpHsuy-ob4fOK6y-7CJzn_CGh7M4wqfmWVfSk0Puj3zH8Ye5iSNY6ORJZOJwtXu_AQlyeoJwVeOez9P3K-9q81PV7f)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXrSDEWs4fuNLMuWiCQioPtxY57NMqpqezZ2h5eJmcx_Q75dnPydY9wdnjYQI3MPPDRMKbxKBAGN3a0AXgwbbg2iL1eKov2xO8M0PkBRB-bmxvL6okAQeyCe_9R2cUWRQZvr6xFPzAnLTIlY3RdPz4HZQuOm1rCqA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXjG7iv7NrkgdOY27AMPr0sfhB3UvulbXoblUly2D49HK1bZzJR8PisAwpsYh37vYI6gJQ34fzvqBzgeAC_bgctFYLik-Xb74TB49g5I0vvF4kOmW7C2XB4xYNHvYG1LymKhCFPA8ItA)
- **Check with a clinician:** Ask a doctor or pharmacist before combining them if you take daily low-dose aspirin, use blood thinners or other NSAIDs, or have a history of ulcers or liver issues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHEIkXXdBE2BETJ2V0gJaRY93nZLTpwzai-_SyD5LYXpc_DCuiQr_mz0iN8nzEBbldWhCi_JRmMCtAcrAw6UIGnby9Z4W3jxvbBKCTY0EZFYlMy6gR235b7lciB1Bwhj-4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXkLt_C0lA3GhRL0g1MLN6c4KRIJl1joyamFSFn5-_rzdpHsuy-ob4fOK6y-7CJzn_CGh7M4wqfmWVfSk0Puj3zH8Ye5iSNY6ORJZOJwtXu_AQlyeoJwVeOez9P3K-9q81PV7f)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX7GYcpo5yJn8kKImmuD0Xh5GoFEVSlOa5oElxqjxbp0Nelmm7ssl9tk3szrcCKZDX-0-ASPsJCEhAGt3f47Gt3UNEZQcUbah6Kf-dpVlrp8kIiEpt0QYmlTIIs8b4COpzrBUwCU_aoA)
